title: Shadow traffic quality metrics PRD: finalize requirements, reviews, and launch criteria
creator: Marissa Cole
project: Shadow traffic tool for eval metrics
description:
Context
Shadow Traffic for quality metrics duplicates a sampled subset of production requests to one or more candidate variants (new model version, quant profile, routing policy, prompt template), scores shadow outputs asynchronously, and surfaces quality deltas alongside latency/cost/error—without changing the user response.

This ticket tracks PRD completion, stakeholder reviews, and launch criteria for the Shadow Traffic Quality Metrics initiative.

Primary doc links
- Confluence PRD (source of truth): sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/shadow-traffic-eval-metrics-prd.json
- Working notes / open questions (Drive): sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/shadow-traffic-prd-notes-working-doc.json
- Console UX spec (for alignment): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-shadow-experiments-ux-spec.json

Scope summary (as captured in PRD)
In-scope for v1
1) Shadow routing policy attached to routes/rollouts
- Sampling % (default + guardrails), shadow targets (variants), metadata/header behavior, fail-open
- Deterministic fingerprinting and bucketing to reduce variance

2) Telemetry + retention
- New shadow pair event types (control + shadow linkage)
- Cardinality limits + enforced dimension allowlist
- Redaction + short default retention, configurable for Dedicated/Private

3) Evals/scoring
- Redwood-provided metric bundle v1 (rubric + heuristics)
- Async scoring pipeline with backpressure and dedupe
- Confidence intervals + statistical significance guidance for deltas

4) Console UX + API
- Create/view shadow experiments, drilldowns, deltas with confidence bands
- Attach quality signals to rollouts (timeline + guardrails view)

Non-goals (explicit in PRD)
- Full offline replay beyond short retention
- Customer-managed arbitrary eval code running inside Redwood (v1)

Personas / primary user stories (PRD excerpt)
- ML Engineer: “I need to know if the new model/quantization breaks instruction following or increases refusal before I ramp traffic.”
- Platform Engineer: “I need guardrails so shadowing can’t blow up cost/metrics cardinality or impact tail latency.”
- Product owner: “I need a clear go/no-go dashboard and alerting for regressions during rollout.”

Success criteria (launch)
Product
- Customers can create a shadow experiment on a route/rollout in <10 minutes from Console, with clear cost/retention warnings.
- Quality deltas reported with confidence intervals; users can segment by safe dimensions (route, model, region, request type) without cardinality explosions.
- At least 3 beta customers complete one real model/version change with shadow quality evaluation and report it reduced rollout risk.

Engineering / reliability
- Fail-open guarantee: shadow path failures never impact user response, quotas, or downstream completion latency SLOs.
- Overhead budgets met (per SRE guardrails doc): p99 user-path latency change ≤ 1% at default sampling; shadow path timeouts and circuit breakers validated.
- Scoring lag SLO met for beta: 95% of scored results available within target window (exact thresholds captured in SRE guardrails).

Security / compliance
- Default retention is short with explicit customer-facing controls; prompt/response redaction is on by default.
- Audit logs for experiment creation/edits and policy changes.

Launch plan (PRD)
- Phase 0: requirements + ADRs + metric set + retention policy
- Phase 1: routing MVP + telemetry + basic scoring; internal dogfood
- Phase 2: Console + alerting + rollout integration; limited Dedicated beta
- Phase 3: hardening + docs + GA

Open questions (tracked/answered during PRD review)
- Q: Should quality signals trigger auto-rollback at launch?
  - Decision: Advisory-only in v1; allow customers to set alert thresholds and provide “recommended action” in Console. Auto-rollback to be scoped in follow-up (see PM-1846).
- Q: Can customers export samples/examples for debugging?
  - Decision: Provide sampled examples view with strict RBAC + redaction + caps. Add export as CSV/JSON (aggregates + limited examples) behind feature flag for beta.
- Q: Default metric bundle size?
  - Decision: Keep bundle small for interpretability + cost: format adherence, refusal/safety proxy, instruction following rubric score, and a “regression flag” composite; expanded bundles in v2 (see PM-1843).
- Q: Dedicated vs Private retention defaults?
  - Decision: Dedicated default short retention; Private configurable with local storage constraints; air-gapped mode does not assume external eval model access (see security/retention doc).
